## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (95%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged image reliability [F6] and backbone disagreement reduce confidence; defer frozen-section margins [F11] and consider drafted recut or deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 95%, InSitu 3%, Normal 2%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Strong Benign score, zero invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 46% reliability (flagged), 88th percentile OOD (error AUROC 0.70) | Atypical input; probabilities less trustworthy |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent backbones split on call |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%) [F5]; top Normal (88%), one InSitu (83%) | Mixed Benign, Normal, InSitu neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.41, contribution -0.88) strongly opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 5, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.44, contribution -0.56) favors benign architecture [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (+0.30, contribution -0.19) [F4]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Score +0.49 (contribution +0.18) nudges up; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell density** (regions 0, 1, 9) · context · 3231/mm² (97th percentile) [F8], 70% fraction [F7], 90th-percentile size variation [F10] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (diff +0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable (0/20 spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Low-reliability frozen-section quality (46%, 88th-percentile OOD) masks in situ disease, matching neighbor BACH_0351 (83% similarity) and backbone disagreement.
- Dense segmented neoplastic nuclei in regions 0, 1, 9 represent true atypia despite small 43 µm² mean nuclear size [F9].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 9**: Verify whether dense segmented neoplastic nuclei (223, 122, 86 cells) are benign epithelium or atypical proliferation.
2. **Regions 1, 5, 7, 10**: Confirm benign tubules over duct-confined atypia (region 7) or nuclear pleomorphism (region 10).
3. **Regions 3, 8**: Check section quality and superior (84%), medial (87%), and inferior (87%) margins before ordering recut or levels.
